note: vespera-bridge WebFlux proxy: a 413 for a declared Content-Length above the built-in 2147483639-byte single-array bound now names that bound and the configured vespera.bridge.max-buffered-request-bytes (servlet parity) instead of reporting the bound as the property value, and a streamed body over a cap above 2 GiB reports the built-in bound with the cap as configured instead of the clamped limit. Docs: the Gradle plugin README says bundleNative=false bundles nothing, not even extraNativeLibs; the JNI benchmark report notes mimalloc is now a default feature. Tests: context-booting bridge tests clear every static native-config knob before and after each test (NativeConfigReset), and the reactive saturation test waits for the event of the request it checks.
